title: Export to ONNX, quantize to INT8, prove the budget
scenario: Corvane's controls engineer allows the anomaly model on the shared ARM gateways only within a written budget, and the reliability lead allows INT8 only if it keeps detections. Build the rerunnable export pipeline: scikit-learn MLP to ONNX, parity check, static INT8 with correct calibration, batch-1 benchmark, and a report with a budget verdict CI can act on.
task: skl2onnx export with a dynamic batch and no ZipMap; parity vs scikit-learn < 1e-4
Static INT8 (QDQ) calibrated the way the gateway feeds the model
Batch-1 benchmark with warm-up: p50 and p95
Budget check and report.json / report.md; exit 0 / 4 / 2
acceptance: Graph contract and parity checks pass
INT8 is quantized, smaller, and within the recall and false-alarm budget
Each budget rule fires independently; report schema; CLI exit codes
ANSWER.md: benchmark table and the limits of a laptop benchmark
